Topic 3.4: Creative writing

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Creative writing. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. experiment with language choice in imaginative writing
2. compose simple texts in written and digital formats
3. engage in writing activity for a sustained period e) demonstrate a sense of ownership in 184 the written work children magazines) f) use connecting words appropriately and effectively in writing g) develop an interest in writing for pleasure Core-Competence to be developed: communication and collaboration: learners work in groups to produce written pieces.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.
